types.description: CM-MSS (4) thermistor motor protection relay, 24-240 V AC/DC, one PTC circuit, 1 NO + 1 NC

document.title: ABB Catalog Electronic Products and Relays 2013/2014

modelingNotes: Exact order selection: catalog 2/96. Nine physical terminal positions and output states: CM-MSS (4) diagram 2CDC 252 016 F0004, 2/100. External reset/jumper: 1SVC 110 000 F0145, 2/99.
Supply capability 24-240 V AC/DC, tolerance -15/+10%, AC frequency 15-400 Hz; no assigned nominal voltage. Exact-order safety supplement 1SVC 437 710 M2000 A2, p.8: <1.7 W DC or <3.5 VA at 50 Hz.
Conditional output ratings: AC12 4 A at 230 V; AC15 3 A at 230 V; DC13 2 A at 24 V. Maximum fast-acting protective fuse: NC 4 A, NO 6 A. Ratings are not unconditional scalar limits.
T2 is shared by sensor and remote-reset circuits. No fixed internal conductor joins different terminal keys. Optional external S1-T2 jumper disables fault storage and must be authored separately.
Contact normal states are de-energized states. Closed-circuit operating principle, fault memory, test/reset and PTC evaluation are not simulated by these static wiring functions.

A1/A2 and T1/T2 are required for monitoring operation. Remote reset and individual output usage are application-dependent. No PE, shield or communication terminal is shown in the complete terminal diagram.
See research.md for source URLs and differing historical short-circuit thresholds and storage-temperature limits; neither is encoded. No safety certification or installation suitability is asserted.

connectionCoverage.notes: All nine marked physical terminal positions in the exact CM-MSS (4) diagram are included: supply, PTC sensor, remote reset and both outputs. No additional bond, shield or communications terminal is documented.
